title: Don't hire Randolph, he will run your band
summary: On an excursion boat, a leader got sore when Randolph played Tiger Rag at his own tempo, and word spread that Randolph runs the band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Were you more by this time as an arranger or as a trumpet player, or was it both?
Were you known more as an arranger by this time, or more as a trumpet player, or was it --
Well, I was known as an arranger, and a trumpet player and a man that would run your band. Don't hire him because he'll run your band.
But it wasn't that. I want to tell
you how that come about. May God have mercy on the man's soul because he's gone, he's no more with us. But anyway, this man hired me to play an excursion boat.

On Lake Michigan, yes, uh-huh. So it came and they says, one of the customers came up, patron, and says, Freddy, ask him, say, would you please play 'Stardust'? He says, -- oh, he very popular, oh, yes, ma'am, I really will. The lady asked for 'Stardust' and we'll play Stardust.
Okay, let's have it. (Musical sounds.) Well, he did that while we were having the trumpet, you see. One-two-three-four, I'd say, dee, dee, dee, dee, dee, dee --

One of those things, see. And the floor, they were playing us just like that. All right, then again, someone would come -- just want to show you how it would go. Someone would come and ask, say, play Tiger Rag. Now, this is -- honestly, this is on the up-and-up. They'd say, play 'Tiger Rag'.
We got to play 'Tiger Rag'. One, two, three, four -- I said (musical sounds).
And he -- yeah, but he would get sore
So, you know what the news came back?
Don't hire Randolph, he will run your band.
